## Checklist
- [ ] the headless tests CI runs (see CONTRIBUTING) print their `*_OK` line, `check_repo.py` prints REPO_OK
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` updated
- [ ] PLAN / LESSONS_LEARNED updated if relevant
- [ ] Wiki updated (`docs/wiki/`): `scripts/gen_wiki.py` rerun after data changes, mechanics page edited after rule changes
- [ ] README, docs and screenshots still match reality (`python3 scripts/check_repo.py` passes)
- [ ] Any performance number quoted was measured with the standard benchmark (8 towns, 8x, all overlays, windowed) and states hardware
